subject: EverGrid exec intro: compact briefing, sponsor routing and coverage
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Erica Morales <erica@evergrid.com>, Jordan Quill <j.quill@evergrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: EverGrid exec intro: compact briefing, sponsor routing and coverage

Hi Erica / Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. We'd love to run a compact executive briefing for EverGrid that shows the Redwood inference runtime and how the routing/coverage model would work for your CTO/VP stack. Goal is 25–30 minutes: 10 min exec overview, 12 min demo, 5 min Q&A + next steps.

Two asks from my side:
- Can your CTO/VP attend (we can be flexible with coverage if one is remote)?
- Any constraints on an evening vs late-afternoon window next week?

I attached a short sponsor brief and the proposed runbook so you can share with your execs. Ben (cc'd) will lead the demo and Laura will cover rollout and SLA questions.

Proposed compact windows (PST):
1) Tue 16 Nov 3:30–4:00pm
2) Wed 17 Nov 5:30–6:00pm (common for East Coast execs)
3) Thu 18 Nov 11:00–11:30am

If none work, share two windows that do and we will adjust.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai

Attachments: evergrid_sponsor_brief_v2.pdf, redwood_demo-runbook.xlsx
From: Erica Morales <erica@evergrid.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Quill <j.quill@evergrid.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 12:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: EverGrid exec intro: compact briefing, sponsor routing and coverage

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks — this looks good. Jordan and I reviewed, and the CTO prefers a late-afternoon slot if possible. Option 2 (Wed 17 Nov 5:30pm PST) looks promising but I need to confirm with procurement on recording and legal for the brief materials (they sometimes ask for a redline). I'm looping procurement on that thread.

If we can lock Wednesday evening, I think the CTO and our Head of Platform can both join remotely for the 25–30 minute run. Otherwise Jordan will stand in for the CTO.

— Erica
Erica Morales
Head of Product, EverGrid
erica@evergrid.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Erica Morales <erica@evergrid.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EverGrid exec intro: compact briefing, sponsor routing and coverage

Erica — thanks for the quick reply. Glad Wed works best. A couple of operational notes to make the 30-minute slot crisp:

- Run order (proposed): 1) 3-min exec intro (Stephanie), 2) 12-min live demo (Ben) focusing on latency/cost tradeoffs and a small integration example, 3) 8-min rollout/ops (Laura), 4) 7-min Q&A / next steps.
- We'll keep the demo on a 256-token tokenized prompt to show per-request economics — helps the CTO see tradeoffs.
- Recording: we can stop recording for any segment if that helps procurement.

I attached the demo-runbook with timestamps and speaker cues. If procurement needs a redline, point them to the doc and we'll coordinate with legal.

Confirmed tentative: Wed 17 Nov 17:30 PST. Please confirm procurement and final attendee list, and I will lock the calendar and send a short calendar invite with dial-in and a link to the runbook.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Stephanie / Ben —

Thanks for proposing. I can make Wed 17 Nov 5:30pm PST work; I confirmed with the CTO and she can join for the first 20 minutes but likely needs to leave ~5:50pm PST for another commitment. Recording is fine from our side; procurement (copied) will reply with any material requests.

Two small asks:
- Could you add a 1-slide security snapshot in the 8-min rollout segment? Either Laura or Ben can do it.
- If the CTO drops at ~5:50pm PST, can you summarize next steps in the invite for follow-up with the CTO?

Jordan Quill
VP Engineering, EverGrid
j.quill@evergrid.com

Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EverGrid exec intro: compact briefing, sponsor routing and coverage — final schedule and small change

Hi all —

Quick update: CTO schedule tightened this morning and she now prefers 6:00pm PST (push by 30 min). I checked with Ben and Laura and we can shift the run + recording to Wed 17 Nov 6:00–6:30pm PST. If that creates a conflict for anyone, please flag now and we will fall back to Thu 18 Nov 11:00–11:30am PST (option 3).

Jordan — we will include a 1-slide security snapshot inside Laura's rollout segment and we'll call out the CT O's early departure in the invite with clear follow-up actions. Procurement — if you have a redline request, please send that doc by EOD tomorrow and we'll route to legal.

I'll send a calendar invite in the next 10 minutes with the updated time, dial-in, runbook link and the two attachments for reference.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
